chapter: Clubs, publishers, unions and life in Denver
title: End of the third session and start of the fourth interview, April 19, 1975
summary: After three and a half hours Horace says he has enjoyed it; Tape 10 begins on April 19 at his home.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: We're about the end of this tape, and I think -- you've been sitting here -- are you aware you've been sitting here for about three and a half hours, nonstop?

Well, this is great to me for a number of reasons because, first, I love this. Music is my life. These particular people that we've talked about, the things that I have said are 100 percent authentic, and they can be proven by men that are living like Dickie Wells, Benny Morton and the guys that participated in these different activities, and they will verify everything that I've said, and I'm happy about it.
That's great. Well, I think maybe we'll close for this session, but there's still some stuff we can deal with in another session.
Knocks me out -- I've had a ball (unintelligible) doing this.
This is Saturday, April 19, I believe, 1975, and we're at Horace Henderson's home once again
